reason: 该插件的用户面向目标是通过给 DeepSeek Harness 的 system prompt 增加“中文思考/中文回复”预设，默认为对话提供中文优先风格，并可通过 config 调整开关、顺序与文本。基于 readme 与 package 清单可见其能力主要是提示词行为定制与配置化覆盖，未展示跨网络、文件系统、终端或外部权限交互能力，因此按低风险分类。

summaries.zh: 这是一个让 DeepSeek Harness 智能体默认使用中文思考与中文回复的插件，并支持通过配置覆盖默认提示内容。
summaries.en: This plugin makes DeepSeek Harness agents default to Chinese thinking and responses, with configurable prompt overrides for enabled, order, and custom prompt text.

capabilities: Injects a Chinese-default system prompt section into DeepSeek Harness agent behavior
Provides configurable controls for enabling, ordering, and replacing prompt content
Ships as a local dsh plugin with only a lightweight schema dependency in its manifest

reasons.code: README documents that the plugin injects a configurable "Chinese Thinking" section into the agent system prompt and allows text override.
Package metadata declares a dsh bundle patch via cordis.patch.yml, confirming plugin-level prompt patching integration.
Repository files and manifest list indicate no external service, CLI, or terminal execution features in this plugin package surface.
